name: bosch-dishwasher-card
description: Home Assistant Lovelace card for Bosch dishwashers via Home Connect

scripts.build: esbuild src/bosch-dishwasher-card.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=bosch-dishwasher-card.js && mkdir -p custom_components/bosch_dishwasher/www && cp bosch-dishwasher-card.js custom_components/bosch_dishwasher/www/bosch-dishwasher-card.js
scripts.build:dev: esbuild src/bosch-dishwasher-card.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=bosch-dishwasher-card.js && mkdir -p custom_components/bosch_dishwasher/www && cp bosch-dishwasher-card.js custom_components/bosch_dishwasher/www/bosch-dishwasher-card.js
